capabilities.notes: The Adjustment.ALL daily and 30m files are real strict-live Alpaca Basic IEX data through 2026-07-17, with explicit hashes and complete-session sets. IEX is not SIP or official-auction evidence.
The registry and packet schema exist, but no real historical or forward PIT packet exists and collection requires a compliant user-supplied SEC_USER_AGENT.
Registry fixtures pass hygiene, but credentials, archive rights, first-seen latency, issuer mapping, deduplication, watchlist coverage, and transcript publication timestamps are unverified.
Provider documentation describes a transcript archive, but no licensed and timestamp-qualified local capability is registered.

sample_data_caveats: Capability fixtures passed registry hygiene but were not used as market or event evidence.
Strict-live IEX files are research evidence, not consolidated execution evidence.
No event fixture, cache fallback, or retrospective LLM output was treated as PIT history.
